title: Partnerships
description: Building a sustainable future requires collective effort. We are proud to work with partners who share our vision of resilience, inclusivity, and ecological responsibility.

current.title: Our Current Partners
current.description: Meet the organizations that trust and support the Lychen ecosystem.

alpsify.description: Alpsify is a web development agency based in Annecy. They support Lychen with technical expertise, helping to build a robust and scalable open-source platform.

humus_and_co.description: Humus & Co specializes in agroecology and soil health. They provide invaluable expertise in sustainable farming practices, training, and project support.

become_section.title: Become a Partner
become_section.description: Join the movement to connect local actors and strengthen territorial resilience. Whether you are a company, an association, or a public institution, let's collaborate to create meaningful impact.
